# EPM2Mod

Firmware mod for the 2012 PEN E-PM2 with film simulations, interval shooting, level gauge and focus peaking.

[Contribution home](https://github.com/cfu288/EPM2Mod/issues). The latest release is the final v2026.11.20, after five release candidates. It includes continuous focus peaking in MF and applies saved film simulations on startup. Spot metering at the AF point is camera-tested by the owner on the main branch but is not in a release yet. A separate Panasonic aperture-ring probe is a developer debug build. The project calls the firmware unofficial and at the user's own risk.
